facts.text: Brooklyn’s Antioch Baptist Church, founded in 1838, doubled as a safe house on the Underground Railroad, helping slaves escape north.
In 2007, Brooklyn residents founded the Historical Society of Brooklyn, Illinois, to preserve the town’s rich heritage.
A 2002 archaeological dig for the Stan Musial Veterans Memorial Bridge uncovered remains of the original Freedom Village, founded by Mother Baltimore.
The 2023 Landmarks Illinois list named Brooklyn a Most Endangered Historic Place, citing population decline and loss of historic recognition.
In 2010, the Brooklyn Historical Society installed a gravestone honoring Mother Priscilla Baltimore at Bellefontaine Cemetery, recognizing her legacy.
